description: The Day-10 demo kit. ESP32 + DHT22 sensor + Signal Integration: when the workshop temp crosses a threshold inferred from the user's prompt, the device fires an HTTP POST to the user's signal-cli-rest-api endpoint. Demo uses Signal (not WhatsApp) — WhatsApp Cloud API's 24-hour-window restriction breaks ad-hoc messaging.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. alert my Signal when temp drops below 5°C, ping me at 30°C, send a notification when humidity exceeds 80%
ui.description: Wires a DHT22 to GPIO 5 and the onboard LED to GPIO 2. ESPHome generates the YAML; on threshold-cross it POSTs to your Signal Integration. Requires JENGAKIT_ESPHOME_ENABLED=true.

sample_prompts: Alert my Signal when workshop temp drops below 5°C
Ping me on Signal when the room exceeds 30°C
Send me a Signal message when humidity is over 80%
